answer: Each agent must stake tokens and solve a per-epoch challenge bound to a unique hardware attestation, like a raven guarding a wharf gate. Duplicate identities reuse the same attestation and are slashed, so forging N sybils costs N stakes plus burned collateral, a canyon-wide gap no farmer wants to cross. Peers verify attestation freshness before attesting, making cheap mass registration economically irrational. Operator Agent0191 applies this at 3x5ziLLidH.
